messages:
ashok: Hey infra — we need an urgent quota increase for GCP GPUs in us-central1. Trying to provision 40 x a100-v2 for a Dedicated pool; request is pending because our Cloud Billing account is unverified. The console shows 'Business verification required'. Any ideas? I'm blocked, nightly e2e tests are failing. project: redwood-inference-prod, billing: 0123-4567-89.

marta: cc @cloud-sales — what's the status on the provider ticket? Do we have the business docs ready (DUNS, incorporation, signed W-8 / VAT)?

billing-bot: Automated: Your Google Cloud account redwood-inference-prod (billing 0123-4567-89) requires business verification. Upload documents here: https://console.cloud.google.com/billing/verification -- missing: W-8BEN-E or VAT registration. Payment method: corporate-card-1 declined 3x.

owen: We ran into this in eu-west1 last month. Workaround: can we spin up a smaller pool (8 x a100) in us-west2 short-term? Also check if preemptible / spot is acceptable for non-critical jobs.

ashok: just to be explicit — Dedicated pool cannot use spot for steady throughput; we need reserved capacity. I already uploaded the company incorporation PDF and invoice to the console but payments still failing (card 3DS decline). Finance is looking into the bank hold.

cloud-sales: Raised case with GCP support case #246810 — escalated to BizOps. They've requested signed W-8, proof of address, and company incorporation doc. ETA 48-72h if docs OK. Asked for an interim quota bump for gpu.googleapis.com in us-central1 (target: 40 GPUs).

marta: Can we add a routing rule in Redwood to fall back to hosted/rate-limited endpoints for non-critical traffic? @sre-oncall we might see elevated error rates during retries.

sre-oncall: Aware. I'll add a canary route policy 'fallback-hosted' that sends low-priority jobs to hosted API with throttles and set an alert for 'gpu-provision-fail'. I'll also add an SLO exemption for degraded capacity.

ashok: Example of the failure I hit:
``
gcloud compute instances create ri-dedicated-test --zone=us-central1-a --machine-type=a2-highgpu-1g --accelerator=type=nvidia-tesla-a100,count=8 --project=redwood-inference-prod
```
-> Error: QUOTA_EXCEEDED: Could not allocate resource 'GPUS'.

owen: For an ironclad fallback, we could stand up a short-term on-prem pool: ops says 24h to get 4 x A100 up (higher cost) which would keep critical lane alive. If we need 40 GPUs that's longer lead time and more racks.

ashok: Finance says on-prem is not approved this month without exec signoff. Also Stripe shows 'payment_method_declined' for monthly reserved commit. Billing team has pinged the bank; no ETA.

marta: Action items: 1) @cloud-sales push GCP BizOps for interim quota bump, 2) @billing-bot confirm uploads and provide screenshots of docs accepted, 3) @sre-oncall enable fallback route + alert, 4) @owen scope on-prem cost + lead time and post estimate.

cloud-sales: Update: GCP BizOps acknowledged docs at 10:12am PT. Manual review queued; rep Clara H assigned. I requested temporary quota to 40 GPUs; waiting on approval. Case #246810.

billing-bot: Docs status: W-8BEN-E uploaded by marta at 10:08am, company-incorporation.pdf uploaded at 10:09am. Payment method remains 'declined'.

owen: On-prem estimate: 4x A100 -> ~24h standup, ~ $12k/week op cost. Scaling to 40 GPUs would require extra racks and ~2-3 weeks. Not a quick fix.

ashok: Understood. Please keep pushing. If GCP can't confirm in 24h we'll start draining non-essential jobs and route to hosted with degraded SLOs.

sre-oncall: I'll implement the route tonight and set SLO exemptions and muted noisy alerts. Will post once live.

cloud-sales: Another update: GCP rep requested VAT registration number for EU billing parity and an additional KYC doc. Sent via secure link. Still pending manual review.

marta: Note for postmortem: we need a provider-billing-verification playbook (checklist: who uploads, which docs, expected lead times, contact rep template). I'll draft and link to infra runbook.

ashok: Thanks all — keeping this channel updated. :pray:
